DNSimpleAccountTokenCredential.title: DNSimple Account Token
DNSimpleAccountTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing ACCOUNT access token, exact account ID and explicit production or sandbox. Bearer header only; sandbox requires separately issued keys. No token issue/refresh, Basic/user-token/OTP/OAuth flow or host fallback. Token kind is a supplied declaration, not provider identity proof. Protected catalog access proves reachability only; scoped permissions and plan eligibility are unknown.
